applies_to: Stage 01 shipment-level classifier (and any later model that scores shipment rows)
prediction_moment: A row is a snapshot of a shipment at its observation timestamp. A feature is legal only if its value was knowable AT that timestamp.
derived_feature_rules: cal_ = calendar features from the timestamp (hour, weekday, month).
lag_ and roll_ = built ONLY from rows with an EARLIER timestamp than the current row (use shift/rolling with closed='left' or equivalent).
eng_ = arithmetic combinations of allowed columns of the SAME row (ratios, products, logs).
forbidden_reason: Target/outcome columns leak the answer. Identifier and bookkeeping columns let a model memorise rows instead of learning logistics. The raw timestamp is replaced by cal_ features.
